title: Interface Implementors Report
summary: Who implements an interface, which method answers each interface method in each class, and who calls or uses an interface member
intro: Use this when you work with an interface: it lists the classes that implement it (directly, through a derived interface, inherited from an ancestor class or delegated by an implements property), the method that answers each interface method in each class -- method-resolution clauses included -- and the call, read and write sites of an interface member. Give it an interface, an interface member, a class or a class method.

help: (interface report: who implements an interface -- lists / via a derived interface / inherited / delegated; which method answers an interface method in each class, resolution clauses included;
the call/read/write sites of an interface member, attributed to it (RB-5); a class: its interfaces and what answers each member; a class method: the members it answers + --uses the sites reaching it.

--json = implementors/1 {target,implementors[],unanswered[],sites[],sites_total,library_implementors,notes[]}; exit 0 answered, 1 no such target, 2 usage/ambiguous; --qname is accepted for --target; chart: ask implementors)

questions.ask: Which method answers this interface method in each class?
Who calls this interface method or uses this interface property?
Which interfaces does this class implement, and what answers each member?
